property.name: LOG_PATTERN
property.value: %d{yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX} level=%-5level service=${spring.application.name:-hsd} env=${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:-dev} trace=%X{traceId:-} span=%X{spanId:-} thread=%thread logger=%logger{36} msg=%replace(%msg){'(?i)(password|secret|token|authorization)=[^\\s,;]+','$1=***'}%n
